notice: Draft Energy comparison scripts based on docs/energy-plan-comparison-data-flow.md. Fields cover the caller's name, supply location, current provider, usage profile and infrastructure add-ons. NMI lookup, CDR smart-meter data sharing, exact bill/feed-in-tariff figures and contact email/phone capture are out of scope for a voice-only demo and are approximated with bucketed ranges or omitted; the official field list and sandbox schema have not been supplied.
opening: Hello, I'm the automated AI Phonease Energy assistant. This is a synthetic demo. With your permission, we will process and save a transcript; May I continue?

fields.label: Caller name
fields.question: May I get your full name, please?
fields.purpose: Personalize the rest of the call. No identity verification is performed against this name.
fields.clarification: Sorry, I didn't catch a name there — could you say your full name for me?
fields.confirmation: I have your name as {value}. Is that correct?

validation.description: A spoken name; letters, spaces, hyphens and apostrophes only, not verified against any record.

fields.label: Supply postcode
fields.question: What is the four digit postcode for the energy supply address?
fields.purpose: Identify the supply postcode, not the mailing postcode.
fields.clarification: Please say the four postcode digits one at a time. I mean the postcode where the energy will be supplied.
fields.confirmation: The supply postcode is {value}. Have I got that right?

validation.description: Exactly four digits; syntactic validation only, not a serviceability check.

fields.label: Energy type
fields.question: Are you comparing electricity, gas, or both?
fields.purpose: Collect which energy services the caller wants to compare.
fields.clarification: Is it electricity only, gas only, or both electricity and gas?
fields.confirmation: You want to compare {value}. Is that correct?

validation.description: One of electricity, gas or both.

fields.label: Occupancy
fields.question: Do you own or rent the property?
fields.purpose: Collect whether the caller owns or rents this property.
fields.clarification: For this property, are you the owner or a tenant?
fields.confirmation: You {value} the property. Is that correct?

validation.description: One of own or rent; do not infer from an address.

fields.label: Moving home
fields.question: Are you moving into this property?
fields.purpose: Record whether this journey concerns moving into the property.
fields.clarification: Is this for a home you are moving into, rather than where you already live?
fields.confirmation: Moving into the property: {value}. Is that correct?

validation.description: Explicit true or false; do not infer a move date.

fields.label: Current provider
fields.question: Who is your current energy retailer — for example AGL, Origin, EnergyAustralia, Alinta Energy, or Red Energy?
fields.purpose: Identify the current retailer so any comparison is measured against the right baseline.
fields.clarification: Which company currently supplies your energy? Say the name, or say other if it's not AGL, Origin, EnergyAustralia, Alinta Energy or Red Energy.
fields.confirmation: Your current provider is {value}. Is that correct?

validation.description: One of the listed retailers, or other.

fields.label: Recent bill available
fields.question: Do you have a recent energy bill handy?
fields.purpose: Route to the most accurate usage source available: a recent bill, or a household estimate.
fields.clarification: Do you have a recent bill in front of you right now? Please say yes or no.
fields.confirmation: Recent bill available: {value}. Is that correct?

fields.label: Recent bill amount
fields.question: Roughly, was your last bill under 200 dollars, 200 to 400, 400 to 600, or over 600 dollars?
fields.purpose: Approximate spend as a proxy for usage when a caller has a bill on hand.
fields.clarification: Was it under 200 dollars, 200 to 400, 400 to 600, or over 600 dollars?
fields.confirmation: Your last bill was roughly {value} dollars. Is that correct?

validation.description: One of the four listed ranges.

fields.label: Household size
fields.question: No problem — roughly how many people live in the home: one to two, three to four, or five or more?
fields.purpose: Estimate usage from household size when no bill is available.
fields.clarification: Roughly how many people live in the home — one to two, three to four, or five or more?
fields.confirmation: About {value} people live in the home. Is that correct?

validation.description: One of the three listed household sizes.

fields.label: Swimming pool
fields.question: Do you have a swimming pool at the property?
fields.purpose: Pool pumps are a major, steady load; flags likely higher usage.
fields.clarification: Is there a swimming pool at the property? Please say yes or no.
fields.confirmation: Swimming pool at the property: {value}. Is that correct?

fields.label: Ducted air conditioning
fields.question: Do you have ducted air conditioning?
fields.purpose: Ducted air conditioning is a major seasonal load; flags likely higher usage.
fields.clarification: Is there ducted air conditioning installed? Please say yes or no.
fields.confirmation: Ducted air conditioning: {value}. Is that correct?

fields.label: Electric vehicle
fields.question: Do you have an electric vehicle you charge at home?
fields.purpose: Home EV charging is a major load; flags likely higher usage.
fields.clarification: Do you charge an electric vehicle at home? Please say yes or no.
fields.confirmation: Electric vehicle charged at home: {value}. Is that correct?

fields.label: Solar panels
fields.question: Does the property have solar panels?
fields.purpose: Record whether solar panels are present at the property.
fields.clarification: Are there solar panels installed at this property? Please say yes or no.
fields.confirmation: Solar panels at the property: {value}. Is that correct?

validation.description: Explicit true or false; an unknown answer must not become false.

fields.label: Solar system size
fields.question: Roughly what size is the solar system — under 5 kilowatts, 5 to 10 kilowatts, or over 10 kilowatts?
fields.purpose: Approximate solar export capacity to help scope feed-in-tariff sensitive plans.
fields.clarification: Is the solar system under 5 kilowatts, 5 to 10 kilowatts, or over 10 kilowatts?
fields.confirmation: The solar system is roughly {value}. Is that correct?

validation.description: One of the three listed size ranges.

fields.label: Concession card
fields.question: Do you hold a Pensioner Concession Card or a Health Care Card?
fields.purpose: Identify concession card eligibility for potential state government rebates.
fields.clarification: Do you hold a Pensioner Concession Card or a Health Care Card? Please say yes or no.
fields.confirmation: Concession card holder: {value}. Is that correct?

true: i have a health care card

messages.resume: We'll keep the details you already confirmed and ask only what's missing.
messages.review: Please review: {summary}. Should we submit these details for further processing? Say yes to submit, or say change followed by the field name.
messages.review_clarification: Say yes to submit these details for further processing, or say change followed by one of these fields: {field_names}.
messages.submit_question: Should we submit these details for further processing?
messages.consent_question: May I continue with transcript processing?
messages.consent_clarification: May I process and save a transcript to continue? Please say yes or no.
messages.confusion: Let's take that one step at a time. {question}
messages.frustration: I'm sorry this has been frustrating. I can bring in a person, or we can continue with one short question. {question}
messages.handoff: I'll ask an Energy specialist to help. I'll pass on the confirmed details and what needs attention so you do not have to start again.
messages.handoff_pending: The human handover is pending. You can ask to end the call at any time.
messages.suppressed: Understood. I've marked this lead do-not-call. Thank you. Goodbye.
messages.declined: Understood. I will end the call. Thank you. Goodbye.
messages.busy: Understood. I will end the call and leave a follow-up request for the team. No callback time has been booked. Goodbye.
messages.completed: Thank you. Your details have been submitted for further processing, and a receipt with the call summary is now available. This is a synthetic demo: no energy plan has been purchased or switched. Goodbye.
messages.submit_declined: No problem, I will not submit these details for further processing. A summary of the call is still available for you. Thank you. Goodbye.
messages.unavailable: A specialist is unavailable. I will leave the context for the team to review. No callback time is booked. Thank you. Goodbye.
